hero.title: Undergraduate Computer Engineering in Germany for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Study high-precision Computer Engineering (Technische Informatik) in Germany across elite TU9 technical universities with tuition-free public degree options, gaining hands-on industry immersion in Europe's industrial engineering heartland.

overview: Germany is a global powerhouse for automotive electronics, industrial automation, and embedded systems engineering. Studying undergraduate Computer Engineering (*Technische Informatik*) in Germany provides Indian students with world-class engineering education at the intersection of electrical engineering, microcontroller hardware, and embedded software systems.

German public universities and Universities of Applied Sciences (Fachhochschulen) offer 3- to 3.5-year Bachelor of Science and Bachelor of Engineering programs with zero tuition fees (nominal semester administrative fees only). Academic training covers microelectronics, digital signal processing, sensor interfacing, embedded C/C++, and industrial robotics, featuring mandatory industrial internship semesters (*Praxissemester*) with leading industrial enterprises like Siemens, Bosch, and Infineon.

International engineering graduates in Germany benefit from intense demand across the semiconductor, automotive, and automation industries. Under Section 20, Paragraph 3, Number 1 of the German Residence Act (§ 20 Abs. 3 Nr. 1 AufenthG), non-EU graduates can extend their residence permit for up to 18 months to seek qualified employment commensurate with their degree, followed by a transition to an EU Blue Card (§ 18g AufenthG) with lowered salary thresholds for engineering bottleneck professions (*Mangelberufe*), subject to a qualifying job offer and official approval.
